summary: 1931 pole lookout replaced by a 1953 53-ft timber tower on the Lolo Motorway; rentals ended for safety, now on standby, listed closed by the Forest Service.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 53-ft treated timber tower (1953); original L-4 cab on a 30-ft pole tower (1931)
facts.status_note: On standby; no longer in the rental program for safety concerns. Forest Service lists the site as closed (page updated 2025-02-19).

access.note: Forest Service lists the site as closed and not available for rental. Treat the tower as off-limits to climbing.

visit.trail_note: Off FS Road 500/557 on the Lolo Motorway, about 3 miles north of Rocky Ridge Lake. Sources differ on distance from Pierce (16 or 38 miles).

corrections.why: The current tower is a 53-ft timber tower with an L-4 cab. 9.1 m (30 ft) is the height of the original 1931 pole tower.
The 1953 date is the replacement timber tower. The site was first built in 1931.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says 16 miles east of Pierce; the Forest Service says 38 miles east off FS Road 500/557. Both are reported; not resolved.

Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe the tower as on standby; the Forest Service lists the site as closed and not available for rental. Both point to no rental; the story reports both labels.

notes_for_editor: Fixes to the record: height_m 9.1 is the 1931 pole tower; the current 53-ft tower is about 16.2 m. Access moved from unknown to closed per the Forest Service page (updated 2025-02-19); the search snippet of a camping listing and a trail guide were not read and are left out. The 1931 pole-tower height appears as 30 ft in NHLR and Idaho Fire Lookouts. No documented staffing history exists. The earlier fs.fed.us URL in the queue record does not resolve; the fs.usda.gov page was used instead. The 16 vs 38 mile discrepancy from Pierce is unresolved and reported as such.
